name: Long Pool with Rounded End
headline: Room to swim, with a soft rounded end.
tagline: A long fiberglass pool with one rounded end and a bright white gelcoat. Shown here during installation, braced and level before backfill.

images.alt: Long white fiberglass pool shell with a rounded end set into an excavation, braced with timber cross-pieces during installation, with pool lights fitted.
images.caption: Braced and levelled during installation

priceNote: Shell only. Delivery and installation quoted per site.

features.title: Rounded end
features.body: One end of the pool is curved, softening the shape and making a natural place to sit or enter.

features.title: Long swimming length
features.body: A longer, narrower shell for laps and exercise without taking the whole yard.

features.title: White gelcoat
features.body: A white interior gives the water a light turquoise look once filled.

features.title: Light ports
features.body: Openings for underwater lights are set in the mold.
